text: Are you currently pregnant, or could you be pregnant?
How many pads or tampons are you soaking through per hour at the heaviest point?
Have you felt dizzy, faint, or noticed you look unusually pale?
Have your periods stopped for 12 months or more (menopause)?
Have you had unexplained weight loss recently?
Do you currently have a fever or chills?
Did the pain start suddenly and is it severe (one-sided)?
Is the discharge foul-smelling or an unusual color (green/grey)?
Have you given birth in the last 6 weeks?
Have you had a new sexual partner or unprotected sex recently?
Does the pain mainly occur during your period?
Has the pain gradually gotten worse over months or years?
Is the pain during sex felt at entry, or deep inside?
Did the soreness start after using a new soap, product, or clothing?
Have the symptoms been present for more than 3 months?
Are you currently using any hormonal contraception or an IUD?
How many days between the start of one period and the start of the next?
Have your periods started yet (menarche)?
Has any breast development begun?
At what age did this first begin?
Have you had headaches or any change in vision?
Has there been rapid deepening of the voice or rapid new hair growth over weeks?
How many months have you been trying to conceive?
Has your partner had a fertility (semen) assessment?
Have you had previous pelvic surgery, PID, or a pelvic infection?
